Caroline (People Ops): Hey all — quick heads-up: our annual attestation window opens next Mon 08:00 PT. We need two things from each team by the deadline: 1) privacy training completion cert for every headcount, 2) at least one SOC2-relevant artifact OR a ticket that assigns an evidence owner. :wave:
Caroline (People Ops): Link to checklist & upload: https://intranet.redwood.ai/attestations (see '2026 attestation' folder). If you prefer, drop artifacts in the secured shared drive: /attestations/2026/<team-name>/
Miguel (Infra): Quick Q — we have a planned infra deploy Mon morning. Any chance for a short grace for Infra on evidence?
Caroline (People Ops): We can offer a 72-hour scoped extension for teams with release blockers. Ping me and @Jamie if you need that. But please still upload certs on time.
Priya (Eng Runtime): What counts as an artifact? Are runbooks + access lists/iam snapshots okay?
Caroline (People Ops): Yes — accepted types: runbook PDFs, oncall rota, IAM export (CSV), config change logs, audit-run outputs, scheduled-backup evidence. Short list (copyable):
```
- Runbook or playbook (PDF/MD)
- IAM access list export (CSV)
- Policy doc with version + owner
- Scheduled job logs / backup snapshots
- Ticket assigning an evidence owner if no artifact yet
```
Lucas (Contractor Ops): For contractors, do we need them to take the privacy microtraining or can team lead attest on their behalf?
Caroline (People Ops): Contractors should either upload certs or have a team lead attestation note in the ticket. We need one of those to meet audit sampling.
Compliance Bot: Automated reminder scheduled: 2026-05-18T08:00:00Z -> will DM team owners with missing items 48h before close. Link: https://compliance.redwood.ai/queue/attestations
Maria (Eng): I'll upload our runbook and IAM export today.
Miguel (Infra): Requesting extension approved for `infra` until Wed 08:00 PT. @Jamie FYI.
Jamie (Security): Noted — miguel, please add a short postmortem-style note if the release overlaps the attestation window so auditors have context.
Tomas (Product): Will product managers need to submit anything other than training certs?
Caroline (People Ops): PMs only need training certs + owner assignment for any product docs used as artifacts. If you use a product spec, attach it and mark owner.
Priya (Eng Runtime): I'll take ownership for eng-runtime evidence. Creating ticket now: `ENG-RUNTIME: attestation owner + artifact`
Caroline (People Ops): Thanks Priya — please tag me in the ticket. Example ticket title we prefer: `TEAM - Attestation 2026 - owner: <name>`
Maria (Eng): :thumbsup: 
Caroline (People Ops): Final note — if you're unsure what to upload, create the ticket and mark it `evidence: pending` with an ETA. Compliance Bot will follow up. We'll post a 24h @here reminder. Appreciate everyone's help to keep the audit smooth. :heart:
caroline-bot: This thread has been pinned to #people-ops for attestation coordination.
